name: screenshot_tool
description: Take a screenshot of the current desktop screen and save it as a PNG in C:\Users\sparr\Desktop\MAVAMBO_COMBINED\coding_agent\workspace_root\man. Optionally capture a screen region and choose the output filename.

filename.description: PNG filename or relative path inside the project. Defaults to screenshot.png.

left.description: Optional left coordinate of the capture region.

top.description: Optional top coordinate of the capture region.

width.description: Optional capture width. Provide with left/top/height for a region.

height.description: Optional capture height. Provide with left/top/width for a region.
